label: Cognitive meaning of supplied contents
definition: The primitive Meaningful predicate marks contents with cognitive significance. SomeMeaningfulContent says that its extension is inhabited. AssertedContentIsMeaningful is an explicit assertion-to-meaning bridge on the selected content only.
note: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Cognitive significance concerns a statement's capacity to say how things are. It is distinct from truth, syntax, verification status and noncognitive expressiveness. The formal predicate leaves criteria of cognitive significance open.
